body.name: Quotient-induced sharp ATT image on the completed stratum
body.construction: \(\widetilde\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\{\psi\in\Theta_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}:F(\psi)=P\}\), \(\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\widetilde\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)/\mathfrak S_2\), \(\bar\tau_P([\psi])=\tau(\psi;P)\), and \(\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\{\bar\tau_P([\psi]):[\psi]\in\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\}\), with \(\mathcal I_{k_0,t}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\operatorname{proj}_t\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\)
